郑和.en: Zheng He, admiral of the treasure fleet

sents.zh: 六百多年以前，明朝有一个很大的船队。
sents.en: More than six hundred years ago the Ming had a great fleet.
The man who led it was called Zheng He.

sents.zh: 他的船非常大，比很多房子还大。
sents.en: His ships were enormous, bigger than many houses.

sents.zh: 一条船上可以住几百个人。
sents.en: One ship could hold several hundred people.

sents.zh: 船上有水，有米，还有很多别的东西。
sents.en: On board were water, rice and many other things.

sents.zh: 他们带着中国的丝、茶和很好看的东西。
sents.en: They carried Chinese silk, tea and beautiful goods.

sents.zh: 船队从中国出发，一直向西走。
sents.en: The fleet set out from China and sailed west.

sents.zh: 有的地方非常热，有的地方非常远。
sents.en: Some places were very hot, some very far.

sents.zh: 他们见到了很多不一样的人。
他们没有去打那些国家。
sents.en: They did not go to make war on those countries.

sents.zh: 他们只是做买卖，然后回来。
sents.en: They only traded, and then came back.

sents.zh: 别的国家的人给了他们从来没有见过的动物。
sents.en: People of other lands gave them animals they had never seen.
Zheng He made the voyage seven times in all.

sents.zh: 所以那时候，很多国家都知道中国。
sents.en: So in those days many countries knew of China.
